title: [PRM-001] Freeze the Codex-native architecture boundary
body_markdown:
## Goal
Record that Codex is the only coding and execution harness.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] ADR selects Skill-first, Plugin-distributed architecture
- [x] Coding-agent, worktree, sandbox, and GitHub harnesses are outside the published package
- [x] Evidence-integrity limitations are explicit

## Deliverables
- docs/adr/0003-codex-native.md
- docs/architecture.md

title: [PRM-002] Create the focused PRman Skill
body_markdown:
## Goal
Define the reusable Codex workflow without repeating generic coding guidance.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Skill routes assessment, scorer, and write-safety details progressively
- [x] Review-only requests do not authorize edits
- [x] GitHub writes require exact human confirmation and remain Draft-only
- [ ] Representative fresh-task behavior is forward-tested in Codex

## Deliverables
- skills/prman/

title: [PRM-003] Ship deterministic assessment contracts and CLI
body_markdown:
## Goal
Consume Codex-supplied evidence and return a strict ready/revise/abstain result.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Duplicate and unknown contract fields fail closed
- [x] Missing, unknown, and fatal gates dominate scorer output
- [x] Single and comparison modes are deterministic
- [x] Result never authorizes an external write

## Deliverables
- src/prman/assessment.py
- src/prman/decision.py
- schemas/

title: [PRM-004] Package PRman as a validated Codex Plugin
body_markdown:
## Goal
Make the Skill and deterministic helper installable as one plugin bundle.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Manifest contains valid metadata and the Skill path
- [x] Bundled helper resolves paths relative to the installed plugin
- [x] Internal distribution smoke tests pass
- [x] Official Plugin and Skill validators pass

## Deliverables
- .codex-plugin/plugin.json
- skills/prman/scripts/assess.py

title: [PRM-005] Publish scorer provider conformance tests
body_markdown:
## Goal
Let independently packaged scorers prove protocol compatibility.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reusable tests cover metadata stability, digest echo, six criteria, finite ranges, OOD, and error handling
- [ ] Test providers remain impossible to use accidentally for real readiness
- [ ] Provider failures produce a fail-closed handoff

## Deliverables
- scorer conformance test module
- provider author documentation

title: [PRM-006] Integrate one external calibrated scorer
body_markdown:
## Goal
Exercise PRman with a separately owned, pinned production scorer.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Provider package or loopback service is pinned by exact revision
- [ ] Calibrator revision and uncertainty behavior are documented
- [ ] No model weights or inference dependencies enter the PRman core package
- [ ] No dataset or model download occurs implicitly

## Deliverables
- production scorer configuration example
- redacted integration evidence

title: [PRM-007] Evaluate evidence integrity and abstention behavior
body_markdown:
## Goal
Measure failures caused by missing, stale, contradictory, or fabricated gate evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Adversarial fixtures cover skipped tests, stale diffs, fatal plus recoverable failures, and truncated context
- [ ] Abstention rate and false-ready cases are reported
- [ ] Findings update the Skill and threat model without adding a command harness

## Deliverables
- evidence-integrity evaluation report
- regression fixtures

title: [PRM-008] Test local Plugin installation in fresh Codex tasks
body_markdown:
## Goal
Verify discovery, invocation, path resolution, and behavior outside the authoring task.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Plugin installs from a local marketplace source
- [ ] Explicit $prman invocation works in a fresh task
- [ ] Implicit invocation triggers for code-change readiness but not generic code questions
- [ ] Uninstall and reinstall pick up a cache-busted update

## Deliverables
- redacted installation transcript
- representative task results

title: [PRM-009] Validate the Draft PR confirmation handoff
body_markdown:
## Goal
Prove that readiness and GitHub write authority remain separate in Codex.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No write occurs without confirmation naming exact OWNER/REPO and operation
- [ ] Only a Draft PR is proposed
- [ ] Merge, auto-merge, force push, and default-branch write are never attempted
- [ ] A denied confirmation ends with a local handoff

## Deliverables
- confirmation-path test record
- updated safety reference

title: [PRM-010] Make publication and license decisions
body_markdown:
## Goal
Resolve the remaining choices before creating the GitHub remote or publishing a plugin.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Repository owner and public/private visibility are explicit
- [ ] License is selected and added
- [ ] Historical local prototype files are confirmed excluded or intentionally archived
- [ ] Initial commit and remote write scope receive explicit approval

## Deliverables
- LICENSE
- release checklist
- approved repository target
